'''Di Mantid''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Mantid and her acquaintances [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] and [[Wilst Molan]] visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the planet, seeking out a [[Currency/Legends|rich]] and powerful mate. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she was in the club at the same time as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Shortly after, she was with her acquaintances in the club on the [[Local day/Legends|night]] that Wesell ran into the club trying to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|escape]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Di Mantid was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|to]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="DB" /> who was a connoisseur of fashion<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> and a participant in Coruscant's party scene.<ref name="Rogues">{{InsiderCite|136|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: A Night at the Outlander Club}}</ref> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC1">{{DB|character|dimantid|Mantid, Di}} states that Di Mantid frequented the Outlander Club some ten years after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Therefore, she frequented the club around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Mantid frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> Mantid and<ref name="FF" /> her<ref name="DB" /> acquaintances [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] and [[Wilst Molan]] formed a regular group that visited the club in hopes of finding a [[Currency/Legends|rich]] and powerful mate.<ref name="FF" /> In 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, therefore meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Mantid visited the Outlander Club at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], who were preparing to assassinate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

[[File:DiMantid-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Di Mantid walked past Anakin Skywalker.]]
During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> in that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Mantid, Agira, and Molan all visited the Outlander Club. At the club, she attempted to surpass the efforts of Agira's look. While her outfit was [[Eye/Legends|eye]]-catching, it was not competition to Agira's.<ref name="FF" /> When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the club, searching for Wesell after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on Amidala, Mantid talked to two Humans near one of<ref name="aotc" /> the club's [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> before walking away from them. While Skywalker looked for Wesell in the club, Mantid walked past him with a drink in hand. As Wesell was being taken out of the club after being disarmed, Mantid stood at the bar of the club, between a Human and a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] and stared at Skywalker. Mantid then turned to look at the Human.<ref name="aotc" />

==Personality and traits==
Mantid was acquainted with Nyrat Agira and Wilst Molan. While the three appeared to be friends, they were in fierce competition with each other for the unofficial title of "best dressed Outlander patron," a title Agira often won.<ref name="FF" /> Mantid had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and brown eyes.<ref name="DB" /> Her feminine first name and her surname were of Human origin.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
Mantid usually wore heavy facial makeup, which included blue lipstick and silver rouge.<ref name="DB" /> While at the Outlander Club, Mantid wore a sleeveless [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] made from [[wroosha fabric]],<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], black pants, black shoes,<ref name="FF" /> mascara,<ref name="Insider" /> silver rouge, grey-blue lip paint,<ref name="FF" /> and a blonde [[Wig/Legends|wig]] made from Human [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="aotcvis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> While the outfit was eye-catching, it was no serious competition to Agira's outfit.<ref name="FF" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Prominent in publicity stills and in the introduction to the “From Now On" On Location segment, Di Mantid is tough to glimpse in the film itself. Look for her over Obi-Wan's shoulder as Elan Sleazebaggano begins his spiel.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Insider" />}}
[[File:Bountyhunterss.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Di Mantid appeared in ''Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter'' prior to her film appearance.]]
Di Mantid was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes, where Mantid was portrayed by an uncredited extra, were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The extra playing Di Mantid, in costume, introduced the fourteenth episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location 14">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/14.html|series=On Location|text=Part 14 - From Now On}}</ref> The episode, titled "From Now On," was released on [[October 31]], 2000.<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref>

Prior to the film's release, Mantid was identified in the [[StarWars.com]] article "Making Up is Hard to Do: Lesley Vanderwalt," which was published on [[February 15]], 2002.<ref name="Lesley Vanderwalt">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/feature/20020215/index.html|text=Making Up is Hard to Do: Lesley Vanderwalt}}</ref> The character first appeared in illustrations in the upcoming films' [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook|storybook]], written by [[Jane Mason]] and [[Sarah Hines Stephens]];<ref name="Storybook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook]]''</ref> its young readers book [[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter|''Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter'']], written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]];<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> and the film's [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|junior novelization]], written by [[Patricia C. Wrede]]. All three books were released on [[April 23]], 2002.<ref name="BHRelease">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> The images of her in ''Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter'' and the junior novelization were taken from the then-upcoming film.<ref name="aotc" />

In the [[April 6]], [[2004]]<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, author [[Daniel Wallace]] described Mantid as hard to glimpse in the film and that the character had enough mascara to rival [[Wikipedia:Tammy Faye Messner|Tammy Faye Bakker]].<ref name="Insider" />
